derived_csv: Numeric columns copied without interpolation. Cf error column retains the source label; no confidence level is assumed. Reynolds stress columns retain source factors 1000; triple moments retain 10000.
method: Use the measured centre-channel Uref near x/H=-4, not automatically the inlet velocity. H=0.0127 m; coordinates match the experiment: downstream floor y/H=0, upstream floor y/H=1. Check upstream Re_theta~5000, delta/H~1.5 and Cf~0.0029. Adjust inlet speed or development length if necessary. Resolve and inspect y+; compare three meshes and time steps; average after startup and report averaging interval. Native SST is not asserted equivalent to NASA SSTm. The 2D incompressible model omits sidewalls and small Mach=0.128 effects.
